title: The headcount recorded for benefits crosses a California training threshold the employment module shows no date for.
detail: California requires an employer with five or more employees to provide sexual harassment prevention training [S:ca-gov-12950-1]. The benefits module records a headcount at or above that threshold and California operations; the employment module holds no training date. Neither module can see this on its own: one knows how many people there are, the other knows whether they were trained.
action: Record the date training was last delivered in the employment practices module, or confirm with your employment counsel that the obligation does not attach to your headcount.
author: Aaron Bollinger
